_comment: Grandfathered apps/desktop complexity violations, keyed PER VIOLATION (rule, file, message) rather than per file: ESLint's flat config can only ever relax a whole FILE, and a per-file list lets every other function in that file drift unnoticed. Regenerate with `node scripts/check-complexity.ts --update` ONLY to record a deliberate, reviewed addition — never to turn a red gate green. Shrink this list; do not grow it.

_comment_accepted: Entries carrying `accepted` were recorded on the owner decision (2026-10-09) that complexity up to 15 is acceptable for a release; the one entry above 15 says why it was not split. The functions above 15 at 0.1.14 (buildSiteRecord 31, shareSiteDirectories 19, deleteProject 17, assertSpecificSiteRoot 17, discoverSiteDirs 17) were split instead. The key is still (rule, file, reason); `accepted` is not part of it, and a later --update drops it.
